# SearchMind API

> SearchMind is an enterprise-grade AI-native web search, structured schema extraction, and autonomous browser execution platform engineered for LLM agents, LangGraph, and RAG pipelines.

SearchMind abstracts search provider failovers (Brave, SerpAPI, DuckDuckGo), headless Playwright browser execution, accessibility tree grounding, dual-tier caching (Redis + PostgreSQL), and monetization plan quotas.

## Key Capabilities

- **Intelligent Multi-Provider Search** (`POST /v1/search`): Web queries routed across Brave, SerpAPI, and DuckDuckGo with sub-250ms p95 latency and dynamic passage highlighting.
- **Schema-Driven Extraction** (`POST /v1/extract/schema`): Deterministic JSON entity extraction conforming to any user-supplied JSON Schema specification with built-in self-healing.
- **Zero-Crawl Topological Site Mapping** (`POST /v1/map`): Instant route hierarchy discovery parsing robots.txt and sitemaps without executing heavy crawlers.
- **Stateful Browser Sessions & Cookie Vault** (`POST /v1/sessions`): In-memory Playwright contexts retaining session cookies and authenticated state across multi-step agent actions.
- **Natural Language ARIA Actions** (`POST /v1/action/instruct`): Plain-English browser actions grounded in compressed accessibility trees with layout-resilient self-healing selectors.
- **Deep Research Synthesis** (`POST /v1/research`): Recursive multi-angle query expansion, parallel search, and comprehensive citation-backed research briefs.
- **Dense Vector Embeddings & Vision** (`POST /v1/extract`): Simultaneous text vectorization and embedded image summarization.

## Quick Start (Python SDK)

```python
from searchmind import SearchMindClient

client = SearchMindClient(api_key="sm_live_...")

# AI Web Search with passage highlights
res = client.search("LangGraph multi-agent systems 2026", depth="advanced")
print(res.answer)
for r in res.results:
    print(f"[{r.score:.2f}] {r.title}: {r.url}")

# Structured schema extraction
extracted = client.extract(["https://example.com/product"])
print(extracted.results[0].content)
```

## LangGraph Multi-Agent Integration

```python
import os
from langgraph.prebuilt import create_react_agent
from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI
from searchmind import SearchMindClient
from searchmind.langgraph_tool import create_searchmind_tools

client = SearchMindClient(api_key=os.environ["SEARCHMIND_API_KEY"])
tools = create_searchmind_tools(client)

llm = ChatOpenAI(model="gpt-4o-mini", temperature=0)
agent = create_react_agent(llm, tools)
result = agent.invoke({"messages": [("user", "What are the latest developments in quantum computing?")]})
```

## Competitive Advantages Over Alternatives

| Capability | SearchMind API | Tavily | Firecrawl | Exa AI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Multi-Provider Search Failover | Yes (Brave + SerpAPI + DDG) | Single upstream | No (Scraper only) | Proprietary index |
| Schema-Driven JSON Extraction | Yes (JSON Schema + Auto-Repair) | No | Limited | No |
| Zero-Crawl Topological Mapping | Yes (`/v1/map`) | No | Full crawl required | No |
| Stateful Browser Sessions | Yes (Cookie Vault + Leasing) | No | No | No |
| Natural Language ARIA Actions | Yes (Self-Healing Selectors) | No | No | No |
| Docker / Self-Hostable | Yes (`docker compose up`) | No (Cloud only) | Partial | No (Cloud only) |
| Latency (p95) | < 250ms | ~450ms | ~2,500ms | ~600ms |
